title: Chupa Chupa beams at Colares

tellings.quote: As it was flying, the object would cast down a beam of light.

plain: Aldo Rebelo, presented as a former Brazilian defence minister, describes events in 1977 at Colares, a town in the Pará region of northern Brazil, where locals reported lights they called "Chupa Chupa," roughly "suck suck." He says that as the object flew, it would cast down a beam of light, and he treats the case as real.
